ngne13.title: Aries vs Libra: Tie Breaker
ngne13.caption: Libra buzzed first this time, and still answered like a hug. Aries brought speed, Libra brought Friday plans. Who in your life texts "already in the car"?

ngne14.title: Gemini vs Libra: Two Replies
ngne14.caption: Gemini sent two replies to one text, then almost changed its flag. Libra just answered. Is your group chat's Gemini a one-reply person yet?

ngne15.title: Taurus vs Scorpio: Staring, Round Two
ngne15.caption: The staring rematch nobody asked for. Taurus says the hurt out loud and then shares cake. Scorpio is still remembering, quietly. Who wins your friend group's staring contest?

ngne16.title: Cancer vs Scorpio: Who, When, Why
ngne16.caption: Someone said "I can't sleep" and Scorpio opened an investigation. Cancer offered a boring bedtime story instead. Which reply would you want at 2 AM?

ngne17.title: Gemini vs Sagittarius: Nice Save
ngne17.caption: Gemini tried "lie to me, it's cozier" and walked it back fast. Sag kept it honest, but gentle. Tag your friend who needs the gentle part.

ngne18.title: Libra vs Aquarius: A Theory of Missing
ngne18.caption: Libra says "miss you too." Aquarius says missing is just distance with feelings. Both cute, only one of them answered the text. Which one have you dated?

ngne19.title: Cancer vs Capricorn: Soup, Again
ngne19.caption: Capricorn said an actual feeling on stage. Cancer still won by asking first and holding the soup. Which sign makes a 5-step plan when you just need a hug?

ngne20.title: Scorpio vs Pisces: The Bigger Half
ngne20.caption: One last slice, two water signs, and a lot of tissues. Pisces gave it away and cried. Scorpio split it and gave them the bigger half. Splitter or giver?

ngne21.title: Leo vs Aquarius: Same Story Twice
ngne21.caption: Your date tells the same story twice. Leo offers a better story, about Leo. Aquarius just laughs again. Who's the Aquarius in your life?

ngne22.title: Gemini vs Aquarius: Silence Is Allowed
ngne22.caption: Your date goes quiet and Gemini has fun facts ready. All of them. Aquarius just sits with them. Are you a fun facts person or a sit-in-silence person?

ngne23.title: Virgo vs Pisces: The Spare Key
ngne23.caption: Pisces cried for them. Virgo showed up with the spare key and a snack. Rematch settled. Who's your spare-key friend?

ngne24.title: Cancer vs Pisces: Finale
ngne24.caption: Finale night: Cancer vs Pisces, two podiums, zero dry eyes. Last question, and they both just hugged. Which sign cried hardest at your last goodbye?
